name: Mushroom
description: Seventies toadstools with spotted domed caps on stubby stems, sprouting at every size across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: translate(@r(-14%, 14%), @r(-10%, 10%)) rotate(@r(-16deg, 16deg)) scale(@r(.6, 1.35)); z-index: @ri(1, 9); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 14%; width: 84%; height: 44%; z-index: 1; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); border-radius: 50% 50% 14% 14% / 100% 100% 22% 22%; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, transparent 6.51%, #000 6.51%), radial-gradient(circle at 58% 30%, transparent 7.7%, #000 7.7%), radial-gradient(circle at 78% 62%, transparent 5.02%, #000 5.02%); mask: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, transparent 6.51%, #000 6.51%), radial-gradient(circle at 58% 30%, transparent 7.7%, #000 7.7%), radial-gradient(circle at 78% 62%, transparent 5.02%, #000 5.02%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 36%; top: 50%; width: 28%; height: 38%; border-radius: 30% 30% 40% 40% / 20% 20% 30% 30%; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
